# Corporate/Site Harness

> Digest-bound gates for Cursor corporate/site delivery. Evergreen factory CLI (`corp-harness`) with evidence-bound phases; agents propose, digests decide, humans approve.

This repository is the factory. Factory rules stay in AGENTS.md. Community and Copilot agents may run the CLI; they never pass `--actor user` and never self-approve.

## Docs

- [How it works](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md): lifecycle, stakeholders, evidence
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): factory rules plus community/Copilot contract
- [README.md](README.md): install, flow, vs LangGraph
- [Copilot instructions](.github/copilot-instructions.md): never-do rules

## Verify

- `python3 -m pytest -q`
- `python3 -m ruff check src tests`
- `./scripts/harness/verify.sh`

## Skills

- [gate-evidence](.github/skills/gate-evidence/SKILL.md): record digest-bound gate evidence with `corp-harness check --run`
- [.github/copilot-instructions.md](.github/copilot-instructions.md): repository-wide Copilot coding standards
- [.github/instructions/](.github/instructions/): path-specific Copilot coding standards (September 2026)
- [.github/skills/code-review/SKILL.md](.github/skills/code-review/SKILL.md): Copilot code review skill
